messages:
carla_sales: Hey infra team — Seabird Health wants a short POC (3 weeks) and asked for a dedicated GPU pool. They want low-latency chat + embeddings. Can we provision something fast? Need region, SKU rec, rough cost, and any blockers for private VPC access.


 dex_infra: Got it. Quick questions: which model and max sequence length? expected concurrent chats / QPS? do they require H100 specifically or will A100/RTX work? also need VPC peering vs customer-managed VPN details.

 sam_se: They plan to run a fine-tuned Llama-2 style model (13B quantized), ~2048 max tokens, median response ~150 tokens. Target: 40 concurrent sessions average, burst to 120 for demo spikes. Embeddings are small and batched. Prefer cost predictability over absolute lowest latency.

 carla_sales: They mentioned H100 in the RFP but said "open to alternatives if we can hit <120ms p95 for single-turn chat". They also asked about mixing SKUs to save cost.

 dex_infra: For that SLO, single H100 is safest for p95 on 2048 with 13B and 40 conc. But we can consider mixed pool: primary H100 nodes for steady-state latency + A100 burst nodes for throughput. Mixing is supported but routing policy must prefer H100 for low-latency calls. We'll need to provision a pool config and a fallback policy.

 toni_security: A few security constraints from Seabird: SOC2 required, KMS key for model/artifact encryption, VPC peering only (no public egress), strict IAM limited to a handful of service principals, and audit log retention 90d. Also they need the Private control plane (not hosted) or at least private tenancy with dedicated pool isolation. Please confirm if we can meet no-egress requirement.

 dex_infra: We can support VPC peering + Private control plane for Enterprise POC, but peering needs CIDR non-overlap and a ticket to networking to accept routes. No-eegress enforcement: we can block NAT gateways and only allow endpoints to S3 via VPC endpoint + KMS. Need customer's subnet IDs and desired egress allowlist.

 sam_se: From product side, recommend config: 2 x H100 for steady, 4 x A100 for burst. Estimate sustained QPS at 40 conc -> tokens/sec demand ~ (40 * 5 tok/s) = 200 tok/s, but bursts ~3x. Is that sizing reasonable? Also we need an estimate of monthly cost for POV.

 dex_infra: Sizing sanity check: with 13B quantized and batching we can hit ~6-8 tok/s per H100 per concurrent session depending on batching. 2 H100 should cover steady with autoscaling + A100 burst. Cost rough: H100 reserved/commit pricing for POC (3w) -> we usually price pro-rata of monthly reserved: approx $9k/node-month => ~ $4.5k per H100 for 3 weeks. A100 approx $2.5k/node-month => ~ $1.75k per A100 for 3 weeks. So 2*4.5k + 4*1.75k = 9k + 7k = ~ $16k hardware cost estimate + networking/storage & support ~ $3k => ~$19k for 3-week POC. Note: these are rough internal numbers.

 carla_sales: Useful — can you also confirm IAM/service principal names we'll need so I can pass to the customer's infra?

 dex_infra: We'll provision a service account: redwood-poc-seabird-svc. IAM roles: redwood.inference.run (to call endpoints), redwood.infra.admin (for pool management limited to our ops), kms:encrypt/decrypt on the provided KMS key. We'll share a minimal policy snippet.

 carla_sales: Great. They'll also ask about timeline — how long to actually get the pool live once we have subnets, KMS key ARN, and peering accepted?

 dex_infra: If all inputs are ready and networking peering is accepted same day, typical lead for dedicated pool deploy + private control plane config is 48–72 hours. Add another 24h for security checklist and canary testing. So 3–4 business days total.

 toni_security: We'll need to run a short compliance checklist before enabling production keys: verify KMS key policies, ensure audit logs to the customer's SIEM or our retention, and confirm no public IPs on pool nodes. Can the on-call window accommodate an afternoon maintenance window?

 ops_oncall: Yes, we can schedule the canary deploy in the 1–4pm ET window most weekdays. Ping me when ready and I’ll reserve.

 dex_infra: I'll open the provisioning ticket and include the initial pool draft.

 deploy-bot: Ticket created: #PROV-4921 — Dedicated pool request for seahird-poc (2xH100 primary + 4xA100 burst). Assigned to infra-team.

 carla_sales: Awesome — I'll send Seabird a one-pager with the cost estimate and 3–4 day timeline, ask them for subnet IDs, KMS ARN, and contact for peering. Will update thread when they respond. :thumbsup:
